sources.entry: Better Agent - Local workspace for Claude, Codex, and Gemini coding-agent sessions with parallel forks and restart recovery. #free

summary.one_liner: Better Agent is a local workspace for running Claude, Codex, and Gemini coding-agent sessions, with parallel forks and restart recovery, according to its listing description.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies only on the listing description from hanishrao/collective-ai-tools. That description says the tool is a local workspace for coding-agent sessions across Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It mentions parallel forks of sessions and recovery after a restart. Specific commands, interface details, and setup steps could not be verified.
use_cases: fork an agent session to try parallel approaches
resume coding-agent work after a restart
compare Claude, Codex, and Gemini coding sessions
notable: supports Claude, Codex, and Gemini coding agents (per listing)
caveats: README not available, so setup, platform support, and dependencies are unverified
listing marks the tool as free (#free), but license and terms are not confirmed
